name: pipeline-iam-and-oidc-trust-auditor
description: Audits the IAM roles and OIDC trust relationships that CI/CD providers (GitHub Actions OIDC, GitLab, Azure DevOps service connections) assume into AWS for over-broad trust, wildcard or unpinned subjects, and stale deploy roles. Read-only. Recommends AWS MCP augmentation (Agent Toolkit for AWS or a custom IAM-analysis MCP) used alongside the connected associations and AWS reads.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on FRI at 06:00 UTC
